text:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 — eu-west1 embeddings latency spike. Multiple 5xxs reported on /v1/embeddings, elevated tail latency. Alerting config: apm>90th, error-rate >3%. Link: https://pager.redwood.ai/alert/3950005555

alice-oncall: I got the page, taking lead. @sam-sre can you pull runtime logs and KV cache metrics? tagging @maria-support for customer comms.

sam-sre: looking. early signal shows KV compaction jobs kicking at ~23:30 UTC causing IO pressure on the embedding store. correlating with increased tokenization latency. running `kubectl logs -n runtime embeddings-*/agent` now.

alice-oncall: good catch. if compaction is the culprit, we should pause compactions and scale embedding pods to absorb backlog. follow runbook: /runbooks/embeddings-high-latency.md -> section 4 (compaction rollback).

sam-sre: paused compaction controllers (patch applied). issuing scale up `replicas: +3` for embeddings-west1. will monitor queue drain. ETA 10m to see improvements.

maria-support: drafting customer-facing copy for status page and email. Early draft: "We’re investigating elevated latency for embeddings in eu-west1. No data loss expected. Our engineers are mitigating; we’ll provide updates every 15 minutes." Thoughts?

evan-product: include note to Dedicated customers in eu-west1 and call out potential temporary throttling if rate-limited. Also cc account reps for high-commit customers.

alice-oncall: agreed. Maria — add a line about mitigation steps (paused compaction, scaled replicas) and an ETA (30m) while we validate. Use status: partial_degradation.

maria-support: statuspage draft below:
```
Status: Partial degradation
Component: Embeddings (eu-west1)
Impact: Increased latency and intermittent 5xx for embedding requests. No evidence of data loss.
Update: We have paused background compaction jobs and temporarily scaled embedding workers. Engineers are monitoring performance; expected recovery within 30 minutes.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when resolved.
```

ops-notify-bot: queued statuspage update for draft review. Preview: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/preview/3950005555

sam-sre: metrics look better after scale-up — p95 latency dropping, error-rate trending down. still seeing occasional spikes but much improved.

alice-oncall: ok, maintain for 20m then start controlled drain of additional replicas. Prepare post-incident notes for handoff. Nina will take night on-call at 23:45 UTC — I'll hand off once we've stabilized.

nina-oncall: acknowledged, I’ll be ready for handoff. please paste runbook steps and current actions into the oncall notes.

maria-support: customer email draft (short):
"We experienced elevated embeddings latency in eu-west1 starting 23:25 UTC. Our engineers identified and paused background compaction work and scaled capacity to mitigate. Most traffic is now within normal ranges; we're continuing to monitor. If you see continued impact, reply to this message or contact support. Expected full recovery within 30 minutes."

evan-product: also prepare a targeted banner for customers with dedicated capacity in eu-west1. We should avoid broad churn notifications.

alice-oncall: decision: mark incident as 'mitigating' on statuspage. schedule a planned maintenance tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC to apply compaction tuning (non-disruptive rolling restart) to prevent reoccurence. Maria — include that planned window in follow-up comms. Ops-notify-bot, please schedule the maintenance announcement draft for review in #announcements.

ops-notify-bot: scheduled announcement draft to reviewers: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/maintenance/3950005555-draft

sam-sre: continuing to watch metrics. will run post-mortem checklist if we transition to resolved.

incident-bot: Update: Recovery observed — embeddings errors < threshold and latency within SLO for last 10m. Marking incident as resolved -> mitigated state. Follow-up: postmortem + customer completion notice once compaction tuning is scheduled and applied.

alice-oncall: handoff to @nina-oncall at 23:45 UTC. Handoff notes:
- Root cause (suspected): aggressive KV compaction schedule causing IO spikes
- Mitigation done: paused compaction controllers; scaled embeddings replicas; monitoring
- Next steps (owner: infra): schedule rolling maintenance 02:00-03:00 UTC to tune compaction and validate under load
- Contacts: @sam-sre, @maria-support, @evan-product

nina-oncall: thanks — I have the notes. will pick this up at handoff and watch for any regression. posting completion notice draft after maintenance: "Maintenance complete: compaction tuning applied; embeddings performance validated in eu-west1; no data loss. If you notice issues, contact support." :white_check_mark:

maria-support: posting final customer follow-up in 30m with maintenance window details and completion template when done.

incident-bot: Thread closed by alice-oncall."
